criteria.description: Validate shipped static GLB, official format validation, scale/origin, exact geometry/texture budgets and provenance.

Inspect eight individual512px exact-GLB views. All three identifying features must read, no visible coplanar overlap, faceted coherent surfaces, full volume. Actual concept three views inspected: flat floor and enclosing limestone relief clear. Outer shape softened asymmetrically and no giant ring-wall regularity. Dominant quiet sediment basin, no copied houses or farm grids from real photographs.

Verify: Elongate broad nearly planar sediment floor dominates the interior. Uninterrupted enclosing irregular carbonate slopes with distinct steep foot-slope break. Quiet basin, variable perimeter height and sparse limestone ledges; no outlet cut or central crater. Preserve uncertainty: Generic geological process/form, original simplified geometry. Kilometer-scale dimensions are illustrative, vertical relief compressed; not Globodol/Planina facsimile, a period, universal tectonic origin or inferred hydrological simulation. Underground drainage is stated context, no invented exposed plumbing.
Verify the frozen brief, complete deliverables and all explicit constraints.
Parse this exact GLB with the pinned target loader and record bounds, materials and errors.
Render this exact GLB in the target graphics runtime; inspect frames and capture renderer/device and measured work.
Render the intended composed scene including this exact GLB; inspect scale/contact/material consistency and measure scene work.
